jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: First Branch Unified School District, a unified union district in the White River Valley Supervisory Union (member towns Chelsea and Tunbridge).
First Branch Unified School District (official district website).

sources.note: First Branch Unified School District board page (White River Valley SU, official): six directors -- Kathy Galluzzo (Chair, Tunbridge, term expires 2027), Susan Kay (Vice Chair, Chelsea, 2027), Stacy Dion (Tunbridge, 2028), Rebecca Savidge (Chelsea, 2028 per the page), Jacqueline Garran (Tunbridge, 2029), Alan Ackerman (Chelsea, 2029). The six are corroborated across the August 25, September 8 and October 6, 2026 minutes. Seats are residency-allocated (Chelsea 3 / Tunbridge 3) but elected by the whole district at the annual meeting (modified at-large; AOE State Board Item Q-2, 2017, quotes the articles: members 'elected by the voters of the entire New Unified District'). The verbatim articles text itself was not located.

First Branch board minutes, June 16, 2026: 'Kathy Galluzzo made a motion to appoint Rebecca Savage [sic -- the board page and later minutes read Savidge] for the open Chelsea Board position until March 2027... Motion passed.' She fills William Smith Jr.'s resigned Chelsea seat; the board page labels that seat 'expires 2028' but her appointment runs only to March 2027.

First Branch board minutes, May 26, 2026: 'Bill Smith has resigned from the Board effective June 17th'. He had been elected to a Chelsea 3-year term March 3, 2025 and served as Clerk through the March 10, 2026 reorganization. Ended 2026.
